## Pull Request Checklist

Thank you for contributing to OLYMPUS! Before submitting, please:

- [ ] I have read and agree to the [Contributor License Agreement (CLA)](CLA.md).
- [ ] I have read the [contributing guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I have tested my changes locally (`npm run dev`).
- [ ] I have run the eval harness (`npm run eval`) if my changes affect agent dispatch or tool behavior.
- [ ] I have rebuilt the skill index (`node scripts/build-skill-index.js`) if I added or modified skills.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` and fixed any errors.
- [ ] My code follows the project's [code style](CONTRIBUTING.md#code-style) (TypeScript strict mode, `.js` extensions in imports, AGPL-3.0 license headers).
- [ ] My changes do not include secrets, tokens, or API keys.
- [ ] I have updated or added documentation if my changes affect user-facing behavior.
